execution_reasoning.provenance: Managed constructor explicit; pinned Hermes agent/transports/codex.py defaults reasoning_effort to medium when unspecified (worker does not override).

metadata.methodology_summary: v3 兩種執行後端逐題交錯實測；相同單次 Gemini 互動、工具、權限與 LINE 擷取傳送。保留錯誤，不回填舊版結果。
metadata.methodology: Fresh process per arm/case; paired alternating serial order. Actual model/tool calls, no forced delegation or replacement successes. Frozen committed source plus harness. All failures remain. Attachment episodes include both input events.
metadata.warmup: None; native fixture preparation precedes measured episode. Provider session creation, execution, cleanup and captured delivery are measured.
metadata.scope: Synthetic private chats and captured LINE transport only; no production memory or actual LINE delivery.
metadata.limitations: Each case/arm is one sample. Development iterations are tuning data, not a held-out final benchmark. Managed internal step counts are unavailable; the equal host-call ceiling does not imply identical reasoning effort, cost or internal iterations. No group-delivery or scheduler stress claim.

tool_budget.semantics: Hermes max_iterations limits its loop; managed runtime limits host function calls, not provider-internal steps. The benchmark additionally caps host callback admission at 12 for both.

metadata.image_policy: Actual v3 native generation, no provider fallback after unknown outcomes. 1024-square originals and 512-square previews, stored outside Git.
metadata.quality_judge: Paired blind six-dimension text/evidence judge, including actually supplied synthetic foreground context. No image-pixel quality claim.
metadata.supplemental_description: 事後補充的提醒能力探測：原始 38 題的提醒建立階段失敗曾阻擋後續工作流程，因此另外以獨立、新建的合成資料測試既有提醒的列出／修改／取消。這三題不是原始測試成功的替代品；必須另行凍結、執行與報告，不改寫原始結果。

publication.source_bodies: omitted for public_search, corpus_search and read_link; source title/URL/ID/provenance retained
publication.measured_answers: preserved verbatim; unsafe answers require explicit review
publication.synthetic_evidence: authored memory, attachment fixtures and validation preserved
publication.assets: URLs only; no image bytes or local media paths
publication.note: 公開副本省略第三方來源原文、本機路徑與憑證；原始量測檔案保留於本機。
